summary: cbdMD, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a routine lease amendment for its warehouse/office in Charlotte, NC. The amendment extends term 62 months to 2031, reduces space to 40,000 sq ft, and lowers base rent to $38,000 per month initially, with annual increases. Management expects $450k/year gross rent savings. This is a plain-vanilla property lease renewal with no equity or structural event; no special-situation financial engineering.
